en.headline: Hong Kong Airlines Okinawa flight returns after gear alert
en.dek: HX676 landed safely with no injuries, and the airline arranged another flight for 160 passengers.
body: A Hong Kong Airlines flight from Hong Kong to Okinawa returned to Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday morning after the crew suspected the landing gear had not fully retracted, RTHK reported.
The airline said flight HX676 turned back under standard safety procedures. The aircraft later landed safely, no one on board was injured, and the plane is undergoing a full inspection.

Hong Kong Airlines said it had arranged an alternative flight for 160 affected passengers, with the journey expected to be delayed by about two and a half hours. It said the incident had been reported to the relevant regulators and that it would cooperate with the follow-up investigation. The airline apologised for the inconvenience.

zh.headline: 香港航空沖繩航班疑起落架未收妥折返
zh.dek: HX676安全降落，機上無人受傷，航空公司已為160名旅客安排替代航班。
body: 香港航空一班由香港飛往沖繩的航班，周日早上起飛後懷疑起落架未能完全收起，折返香港國際機場。港台報道，客機其後安全降落，機上無人受傷。
航空公司表示，HX676機組為保障飛行安全，按照標準程序決定折返。飛機現正接受全面檢查。
香港航空說，已為160名受影響旅客安排替代航班，預計行程延誤約兩個半小時。公司表示已通報相關監管部門，並會配合調查，就事件造成不便致歉。
